channel.title: Dads for Christ
channel.description: Encouragement for fathers, families, faith, leadership, and living boldly for Jesus Christ.

item.title: Go After the One
item.description: Jesus leaves the ninety and nine to go after the one lost sheep. The first mission field for a man is his own home, then the one man who has wandered from God, and being present is how he goes after them.

item.title: As for Me and My House
item.description: Joshua 24:15 calls a man to decide, and to lead, that his household will serve the Lord. When he is present in worship, his wife, his children, and his home receive a clear direction in a busy age.

item.title: Do Not Grow Weary
item.description: The long work of a husband and a present father can make a man want to quit. Galatians 6:9 calls him to keep doing good at home, and a wife, a child, and a house are steadied when he does not give up.

item.title: Love Her as Christ
item.description: A man who loves his wife as Christ loved the church spends himself for her good, and that love steadies the marriage, teaches the children, and gives the home the shape of Jesus.

item.title: A Soft Answer
item.description: Anger rises in every marriage and every home. A man who answers softly turns the heat down, protects his wife and children, and shows them Christ.

item.title: Before the Sun Goes Down
item.description: Husbands and wives face anger together. A man who will not let the sun go down on his wrath keeps bitterness from settling on his wife, his children, and his home.

item.title: Teach Them Diligently
item.description: Faith is handed down at the dinner table, in the truck, and at bedtime, when a man talks of God's words there and not only on Sunday.

item.title: A Place of Refuge
item.description: A present father gives his children a refuge, stands beside his wife, and teaches the home whom it serves.

item.title: Pray With Her
item.description: Husbands and wives face real battles together. A husband who takes the lead in praying with his wife strengthens the marriage and the home.

item.title: More Than a Paycheck
item.description: A paycheck can keep a household, and God calls a father to provide. Children still need his time, his attention, and a man who will lead them to Jesus.

item.title: Stay in the Room
item.description: Husbands and wives fight real battles. A father who stays in the room — listening, repenting, and praying — changes the temperature of the home.

item.title: What It Means to Reach One
item.description: Jesus left the ninety-nine to go after the one. That same mission still matters today. Who is the one person God may be calling you to pray for, encourage, and point back to Him?
